name: mirage
text: Straight answer: from the numbers I have, the heaviest things on the phone are (1) the 8 MB bets file, rewritten whole on every change (the trim in v1.0.123 only starts once your history is on GitHub, so the 13:00 report still showed 8.4 MB; the next one will show whether it shrank), and (2) a new engine list swapped into the screen every ~8 s (the log shows a scan 'finishing' about 10 times a minute), which redraws the lists each time. I can't tell which one is the lag without profiling your phone, and I won't ship guesses that could break bets. v1.0.124 now splits slow frames by tab, so the report after you use the app for a few minutes will name the screen and the cause. Also: Battery Saver slows the whole phone; turning it off for Vigilant will help right away. I'll cut whatever that report points at the moment it lands.
